    Count the respondents reached

    marginal_activations.Rd

    Counts the respondents marked as reached by get_activations(). On the full data this is a combination's reach. On data limited to respondents not already reached by some other products, it is the combination's marginal reach: how many new respondents it adds.

    marginal_activations(vec)

    Arguments

    vec

    A logical vector from get_activations().

    Value

    A single integer: the number of respondents reached.

    Examples

    # Reach of a combination
marginal_activations(get_activations(am, c("northwind", "may")))
#> [1] 3210

# Respondents "may" adds beyond those "northwind" already reaches
not_reached <- am[!get_activations(am, "northwind"), ]
marginal_activations(get_activations(not_reached, "may"))
#> [1] 1854
